youtube_title: Same Food Costs MORE on Delivery Apps 🍗 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Butter chicken: ₹340 on the app, ₹300 on the menu. Not a coincidence.

Jefferies checked 80 restaurants: 80% charged more online. The median premium was 10-11%, and about 1 in 5 charged 30%+ more. Apps take a commission per order, and restaurants push that cost into the menu price. Then come delivery, platform and packing fees on top.

Rule: restaurant nearby? Call them directly, compare the dine-in price, or pick it up.

Source: Jefferies report, via Inc42 (Aug 2022).
